remarks: Beautifully situated within a charming Victorian mansion, this 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit offers character, convenience, and modern comfort just minutes from downtown Stamford. Enjoy easy access to public transportation, restaurants, shopping, and entertainment. The unit features an open-concept kitchen and living area, creating a bright and inviting space perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Step outside onto your private deeded deck offering approximately 200 square feet of outdoor space - ideal for relaxing or unwinding after a long day. Down the hall, you'll find a generously sized bedroom and full bathroom, along with ample closet space throughout. Additional highlights include an in-unit Miele washer and dryer and convenient basement storage space. A perfect blend of historic charm and modern living in a prime location.
